text:
Maria (Finance): FYI we just got a late vendor invoice that pushes ~$48.2k of usage into March. Need decision: record as prior-period adj to match service period or accrue in April? @Jon (RevenueOps) @Devon (Billing) @sam (Audit)

bot-invoices: New invoice #489201 received: https://invoices.redwood.local/489201. Invoice date: 2026-03-25. Service period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31. Amount: $48,245.12. Attached: scanned_PDF.

Devon (Billing): Pulled the billing run 11:30AM ET2. ETL lag caused usage to land late. CSV extract (top rows):
customer_id,usage_date,tokens,amount
ACME-001,2026-03-28,1_240_000,1200.00
NIMBUS-12,2026-03-30,5_600_000,5400.00
SPROUT-7,2026-03-31,18_000_000,41645.12
No dupes in ledger, looks like one big account (SPROUT-7) and misc.

Jon (RevenueOps): Materiality and matching principle suggest a March prior-period adjustment. Proposed JE for review: Date 2026-03-31 Dr Accounts Receivable 48,245.12 / Cr Deferred Revenue 48,245.12. We'll link invoice 489201 to the deferral line and amortize per existing schedule.

sam (Audit): +1 for prior-period adj. Requirements: 1) rationale memo, 2) invoice + service period evidence, 3) approver sign-offs. Tag JE as "post-close prior period". Confirm ARR/quarter metric impact (should be immaterial but call out).

Leigh (Sales Ops): Heads up 1ricing experiment note: SPROUT-7 is owed a retro credit (~$5k) from the pricing experiment run last week. Sales wants to apply the credit on the customer's next invoice (April) for UX reasons. How do we reflect that if we book March gross?

Devon (Billing): Options: net the credit in March (reduces AR) or book a separate Customer Credit Liability and keep the gross into deferrals. If we want clean AR, netting JE would be Dr AR 48,245.12 / Cr Deferred Revenue 43,245.12 / Cr Customer Credit Liability 5,000.00 (date 2026-03-31). Alternatively, post gross into March and only reduce AR when the credit is issued in April.

Maria (Finance): Audit leans prior-period adj and Sales leans credit in April. My recommendation: book gross into March deferrals and record Customer Credit Liability $5k. That keeps revenue timing aligned while tracking credit separately until applied. I'll draft the memo and circulate for sign-offs.

Jon (RevenueOps): Will update the revenue schedule to include invoice 489201 (gross) and add the amortization line. Also tagging impacted customers so Optimize won't recommend changes based on this usage run.

sam (Audit): Approve the "gross + credit liability" approach. Please route memo to audit@redwood.com and cc finance@redwood.com with attachments (invoice PDF, billing CSV extract).

Devon (Billing): After memo approval I'll prepare the JE and attach supporting docs. I'll also create the April credit memo draft for SPROUT-7 so Sales can confirm messaging.

Maria (Finance): Action items: 1) I'll write the memo and circulate (target: EOD), 2) @Devon to prepare JE after approvals, 3) @Jon to update rev schedule, 4) @Leigh to confirm customer comms for April.

Jon (RevenueOps): Added to close checklist: flag delayed-usage invoices and include monthly ETL health check so this hits us earlier.

sam (Audit): Approved - awaiting memo.

Maria (Finance): Thanks all. I'll post the memo link here when it's ready and then close the thread.
